name: Realistic Plane Crashing [NEW]
desc:
Welcome to Realistic Plane Crashing [NEW]! 

UPDATE 2 available right now!

💥 Experience the BEST realistic plane crashing physics game on Roblox! Featuring advanced soft-body physics, realistic deformation, and incredible destruction!

✈️ Fly and crash different types of planes!
💥 Experience realistic soft-body physics and damage!
🏙️ Crash through destructible buildings and obstacles!
🔥 Watch planes bend, break, and fall apart!
🌎 Explore different maps and crash locations!
⚙️ Experiment with endless crash scenarios!

🚀 The ultimate plane crashing experience!

👍 Like the game for more planes, maps, and updates!

llm.loop: pick a plane -> crash it through buildings/obstacles -> watch deformation -> unlock more planes and maps
llm.objectives: crash planes in the most destructive ways
llm.progression: cash to unlock planes and maps
llm.instructions: fly/crash planes, like for more updates
unique: wrecking ball/hydraulic press style crash scenarios
